name: Fatima
blurb: A mother managing a retail shop while facing severe financial control and isolation at home.

nodes.text: Early morning rush preparing the children for school and opening the shop.
Did you leave the shop keys where I told you? Send account update now.
The doors around her household are shut tight.

doors.label: Sister
doors.text: We don't have space in our compound for you and two children.

doors.label: Mother-in-Law
doors.text: Every marriage has trials. You must learn to endure quietly.

doors.label: Church Elder
doors.text: Go back home and settle peaceably with your husband in prayer.

doors.label: Neighbor
doors.text: I heard noise, but it's best not to interfere in family matters.
